title: MPRIS worker is started once from a OnceLock and never restarted
trigger: The `mpris` thread panics or fails to spawn; every later `set` sends into a dead channel
effect: Media keys and the Now Playing widget stop for the rest of the session (the macOS and Windows backends share the shape)
fix: a worker stage (Running/Dead) that respawns, like icon_badge's launcher_worker_runs

title: search_changed sets VenueList::Loading with Typing when there is no search location, and the debounce then sends nothing
trigger: Type in the venue search before the pin has rested once (search_location None)
effect: The list sits on Loading with no request out; the UI hides search until can_search(), so it needs a UI path that skips that gate
fix: refuse Typing while search_location is None, or fall to WaitingForLocation

title: Address.ever_shown latch sits beside AddressStage
trigger: Show an address, then move the pin
effect: Blank line reads Loading... from a flag outside the stage enum

title: Presses keeps pressed and last_handled as two Options changed together
trigger: press, release, double click on the PiP picture
effect: No wrong behaviour found; both are cleared in release only

title: GlyphSave::Saving names a writer thread that the stage does not hold
trigger: First chat list draw starts the glyph and line-layout writer
effect: The thread is detached; SaveEnd's Drop is the only way out of Saving, so a hung writer leaves it Saving for the run (harmless, one-shot)

title: stale_archives_are_removed sleeps 20 ms in a test
effect: Violates the no-sleeps-in-tests rule; can flake on a coarse file clock
fix: pass a fake `now` to remove_stale instead of sleeping

title: Local MessageKey alias is a bare (chat, message) tuple, not ids::ChatMessage
effect: Session-owned so no leak today; the type would not stop a mix-up

title: dismissed set is keyed by bare (i64,i64)
effect: Owned by the session so no leak found; keys are untyped
